testsuite.name: TicketService - Submission Rate Limiting

testcase.name: should allow submission when resident has not reached the rate limit
should reject submission when resident has exceeded the rate limit
rate limit should be per-resident, not global
should include waiting period information in error message
should check rate limit with correct time window
should reject submission when resident has reached the rate limit
should use default rate limit configuration when none specified
should allow submission when count is zero
